symptom: The v354 deny-only catalog test pinned top-level field names, global custody rules and 18 denial cases but did not validate sourceRefs values. A catalog with a deleted, duplicated, replaced or authority-looking injected evidence reference would still satisfy the existing static contract test. This was a specification provenance-integrity gap, not executed verifier evidence or production/scoring authorization.
lesson: A closed JSON top-level key vocabulary does not validate the meaning of a nested provenance list. Reviewers can be misled by substituted or forged evidence references even when every negative vector remains unscorable.
guardrail: Pin the exact reviewed sourceRefs set independently in a static contract test; reject deletion, duplication, substitution and appended authority-looking references. References remain navigation only, never independent proof or an authorization gate; reviewed additions require an explicit synchronized test update.
